answer: The device submits an attestation of its authorized repair history, signed by certified service centers. The history is an island of records: every screen, battery, and board replacement is logged. Service records stamped in saffron make the history auditable. A gale of fake histories fails because service centers sign with keys the network trusts. A farm that swaps boards to multiply identities is exposed, because the repair log cannot account for one board becoming many devices.
